proposal.hypothesis: One 256-thread group per row with register caching of 4 elements/thread and threadgroup max/sum reductions minimizes global passes and exp evaluations for 256x1024 softmax.

One 256-thread group per row with register caching and SIMD max/sum reductions replaces many threadgroup-barrier reduction steps, cutting synchronization and global-memory passes for 256x1024 softmax.
